s: KakAraH । sa tu vyaYjanadvitIyavarRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnaM kaRWaH । (yaTA, sidDAntakOmudyAm । “a-ku-ha-visarjjanIyAnAM kaRWaH .” iti । SikzAgranTe tu asya jihvAmUlIyatvamuktam । yaTA, -- “jihvAmUle tu kuH proktaH .” iti । paraM jihvAmUlIyasyApi kaRWamUloccAraRaparatvAt na dozAya eva ॥) yaTA, kAmaDenutantre । “KakAraM paramAScaryyaM SaNKakundasamapraBam । koRatrayayutaM SUnyaM bindutrayasamanvitam ॥ guRatrayayutaM devi ! paYcadevamayaM sadA । triSaktisaMyutaM varRaM KakAraM praRamAmyaham ॥” tasyotpattiryaTA, prapaYcasAre । “sa sargaH SlezitaH kaRWe vAyunA kAdimIrayet । vargasparSanamAtreRa kaM svarasparSanAttu Kam ॥” (vaNgAkzarEH) tasya leKanaprakArAdiryaTA, -- “SivarUpA vAmareKA dakzareKA prajApatiH । aDoreKA vizRurUpA sAkzAdbrahmasvarUpiRI ॥ vAmAdvAmagatA reKA vahrirUpA ca sA smftA । mAtrA kuRqalinI sAkzAt KakAraH paYcadEvataH ॥ DyAnamasyAH pravakzyAmi SfRuzva kamalAnane ! । banDUkapuzpasaNkASAM ratnAlaNkAraBUzitAm ॥ varABayakarIM nityAmIzadDAsyamuKIM parAm । evaM DyAtvA brahmarUpAM tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ * ॥ tasya nAmAni yaTA, nAnAtantrezu, -- “KaH pracaRqaH kAmarUpI fdDirvahniH sarasvatI । AkASamindriyaM durgA caRqISastApinI guruH ॥ SiKaRqI dantajAtISaH kaPoRirgaruto yadi । SUnyaM kapAlI kalyARI sUrpakarRI'jarAmaraH । SuBrAgneyA caRqaliNgo janA vyaNgAraKaqgakO ॥”

klI, (Karvvati mano'smin Kanyate kzuByate mano'nena vA । Karvva gatO, Kana dAraRe vA anyeByopIti qaH .) indriyam । (yaTA, manO । 2 । 60 । “trirAcAmedapaH pUrvvaM dviH pramfjyAt tato muKam । KAni cEva spfSedadBirAtmAnaM Sira eva ca ॥”) puram । kzetram । SUnyam । (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 88 । 7 । “patasyudIrRAmbuDarAnDakArAt KAt KecarARAM pravaro yaTArkaH ॥”) binduH । (yaTA, lIlAvatyAM kzetravyavahAre । “vedAgnivARaKASvESca KaKABrABrarasEH kramAt ॥”) AkASam । (yaTA, manO । 12 । 120 । “KaM sanniveSayet Kezu cezwanasparSane'nilam ॥” “KaM vAhyAkASaM Kezu udarAdyavaCinnaSarIrAkASezu .” iti kullUkaBawwaH ॥) saMvedanam । devalokaH । Sarmma । iti medinI । Ke । 1 ॥ lagnAt daSamarASiH । iti dIpikA ॥ (yaTA, jAtakaprakaraRe । “tanuniDanaKaBeSAH kendrakoRe trilABe ॥”) aBrakam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (SabdatanmAtram । yaTA, maRqUkopanizadi । “etasmAjjAyate prARo manaH sarvvendriyARi ca । KaM vAyurjyotirApaH pfTvI sarvvasya DAriRI ॥” cidAnandamayabrahmAkASam । yaTA, CAndogyopanizadi “kaM brahma KaM brahma yadeva kaM tadeva KaM gaNkAkAro vE puruzo GakAro GozayaMstaTA ॥” Cidram । yaTA BAgavate । 7 । 12 । 25 । “Ke KAni vAyO niHSvAsAMstejasyuzmARamAtmavAn ॥”)
puM, (Karvvayati svaraSmiBiriti । Karvva + antarBUtaRic + qaH .) sUryyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: KakAraH “jihvAmUle tu kuH proktaH” SikzokteH kaRWamUloccAryyaH jihvAmUlapadasya kaRWamUlaparatvAt । asyoccAraRe AByantaraprayatnaH spfzwatA (jihvAmUlasparSaH) bAhyaprayatnASca “KayAM yamaH KayaH + ka~ pO visargaH Sara eva ca । eve SvAsAnupradAnA aGAzASca vivfRvate । kaRWam” iti SikzokteH SvAsAGAzabivArAH “ayugmAvargayamagAyaRaScAlpAsavaH smftAH” iti SikzokteH vargamaDye yugmavarRatvAt mahAprARaSca । KAdiSabde pare pUrvasTa visargasya sTAne jihvAmUlIyaH yaTA maRe + KaniH samAse tu vA satvaYca । BA + KaraH BAsKaraH BAHKara iti । varRRABiDAne asya vAcakAH SabdAdarSitAH yaTA “KaH pracaRqaH kAmarUpI SudDirvahniH sarasvatI । AkASEndriyaM durgA caRqI santApinI guruH । SiKaRqI dantojAtISaH kaPoRirgaruqogadI । SUnyaM kapAlI kalyARI sUrpakarRo'jarAmaraH । SuBAgneya caRqaliNge jano JaNkAraKaqgakO” । asya mAtfkAvarRAntargatatvena DyeyarUpaM varRodDAratantre uktaM yaTA “banDUkapuzpasaNkASAM ratnAlaNkAraBUzitAm । varABayakarIM nityAmIzadDAsyamuKIM parAm । evaM DyAtvA KasvarUpAM tanmantra daSaDA japet” । mAtfkAnyAse cAsya bAhO nyasyatA । SlokaracanAyAM tasyAdyavarRatayopanyAse granTakarttuH lakzmIkaratA “kaH KogoGaSca lakzmIM vitarati viyaSoNaHsuKaM caH suKaM CaH” vfttara॰ wIkAvftaDfvAkyAt ।

m: 1. ख the second consonant of the alphabet (being the aspirate of the preceding consonant; often in MSS. & Inscr. confounded with ष).
2. ख अम्, m. the sun, L.
3. ख n. (√ खन्) a cavity, hollow, cave, cavern, aperture, RV.

an aperture of the human body (of which there are nine, viz. the mouth, the two ears, the two eyes, the two nostrils, and the organs of excretion and generation), AV. xiv, 2, 1 and 6; Prāt.; KaṭhUp.; Gaut.; Mn. &c.
(hence) an organ of sense, BhP. viii, 3, 23
(in anat.) the glottis, W.
‘the hole made by an arrow’, wound, Mn. ix, 43
the hole in the nave of a wheel through which the axis runs, RV.; ŚBr. xiv
vacuity, empty space, air, ether, sky, ŚBr. xiv; PraśnUp.; Mn. xii, 120 &c.
heaven, L.
Brahma (the Supreme Spirit), W.
(in arithm.) a cypher, Sūryas.; Sāh.
the Anusvāra represented by a circle (बिन्दु), L.
N. of the tenth astrological mansion, VarBṛ.
talc, L.
a city, L.
a field, L.
happiness (a meaning derived fr. सु-ख, दुः-ख), L.
action, L.
understanding, L.
ख [cf. Gk. χάος; Lat. halo.]
a: खः — The sun. --खं 1 The sky; खं केशवोऽपर इवाक्रमितुं प्रवृत्तः Mk. 5. 2; यावद्रिरः खे मरुतां चरंति Ku. 3. 72; Me. 9. --2 Heaven. --3 Organ of sense. --4 A city. --5 A field. --6 A cypher. --7 A dot, an anusvāra. --8 A cavity, an aperture, hollow, hole; Ms. 9. 43. --9 An aperture of the human body; (of which there are 9, i. e. the mouth, the two ears, the two eyes, the two nostrils, and the organs of excretion and generation); खानि चैव स्पृशेदाद्भिः Ms. 2. 60, 53; 4. 144; Y. 1. 20; cf. Ku. 3. 50. --10 A wound. --11 Happiness, pleasure. --12 Talc. --13 Action. --14 Knowledge. --15 Brahman. --16 The glottis (in anatomy). --17 The tenth from any given constellation or the sun's entrance into it. --खा 1 A well, fountain. --2 A river --Comp. --अटः (खेऽटः) {1} a planet. {2} Rāhu, the ascending node. --आपगा an epithet of the Ganges. --उल्कः {1} a meteor. {2} a planet. --उल्मुकः the planet Mars. --कामिनी N. of Durgā. --कुंतलः N. of Śiva. --खोल्कः ‘sky meteor,’ N. of the sun. ˚आदित्यः a form of the sun. --ग a. [खे आकाशे गच्छति गम्-ड] moving in the air. --(गः) {1} a bird; अधुनीत खगः स नैकधा तनुं N. 2. 2; Ms. 12. 63. {2} air, wind; तमांसीव यथा सूर्यो वृक्षानग्निर्घनान्खगः Mb. {3} the sun. {4} a planet; e. g. आपोक्लिमे यदि खगाः स किलेंदुवारः Tv. {5} a grasshopper. {6} a deity. {7} an arrow. ˚अधिपः an epithet of Garuḍa. ˚अंतकः a hawk, falcon. ˚अभिरामः an epithet of Śiva. ˚आसनः {1} the eastern mountain on which the sun rises. {2} an epithet of Viṣṇu. ˚इंद्रः, ˚ईश्वरः, ˚पतिः epithets of Garuḍa. ˚वती f. the earth. ˚स्थानं {1} the hollow of a tree. {2} a bird's nest. --गंगा celestial Gaṅgā. --गतिः f. {1} flight in the air. {2} the motion of a planet. --गम a. moving in the air, flying (as the Gandharvas or missile weapons). --(मः) a bird. --(खे) गमनः a kind of gallinule. --गुण a. having a cypher as a multiplier. --गोलः the celestial sphere. ˚विद्या astronomy. --चमसः the moon. --चर a. flying, moving in the air. --(रः) or खेचरः {1} a bird. {2} a cloud. {3} the sun. {4} the wind. {5} a demon. {6} an aerial spirit. {7} a Gandharva or Vidyādhara. {8} a planet. {9} mercury or quicksilver. 10 a sign of the zodiac. (--री i. e. खेचरी) {1} a semi-divine female able to fly. {2} an epithet of Durgā. --चारिन् a. moving in the air. (--m.) an epithet of Skanda. --जलं ‘sky-water’, dew, rain, frost &c. --ज्योतिस् m. a firefly. --तमालः {1} a cloud. {2} smoke. --तिलकः the sun. --द्योतः {1} a firefly; खद्योतालीविलसितनिभां विद्युदुन्मेषदृष्टिं Me. 81. {2} the sun. --द्यातनः the sun. --धूपः a rocket; मुमुचुः खधूपान् Bk. 3. 5. --परागः darkness. --पुष्पं ‘sky-flower’, used figuratively to denote anything impossible, an impossibility; cf. the four impossibilities stated in this verse: --मृगतृष्णांभसि स्नातः शशशृंगधनुर्धरः . एष वंध्यासुतो यति खपुष्पकृतशेखरः Subhāṣ. --भं a planet. --भ्रांतिः a falcon. --मणिः ‘the jewel of the sky’, the sun. --मूर्तिः an epithet of Śiva. --वारि n. rain-water, dew &c. --बाष्पः snow, hoar-frost. --शय (also खेशय) a. resting or dwelling in the air. --शरीरं a celestial body. --श्वासः wind, air. --समुत्थ, --संभव a. produced in the sky. --सिंधुः the moon. --स्तनी the earth. --स्फटिकं the sun or moon gem. --हर a. having a cypher for its denominator.

k.v: द्योदिवौ द्वे स्त्रियामभ्रं व्योम पुष्करमम्बरम्. नभोऽन्तरिक्षं गगनमनन्तं सुरवर्त्म खम्. वियद्विष्णुपदं वा तु पुंस्याकाशविहायसी। विहायसोऽपि नाकोऽपि द्युरपि स्यात्तदव्ययम्. तारापथोऽन्तरिक्षं च मेघाध्वा च महाबिलम्. विहायाः शकुने पुंसि गगने पुन्नपुंसकम्.।
मयूखस्त्विट्करज्वालास्वलिबाणौ शिलीमुखौ। शङ्खो निधौ ललटास्थ्निकम्बौ न स्त्रीन्द्रियेऽपि खम्.।
